buildLabel: worktree build identifier supplied by the operator

sessionFlow.projectName: fixture project name shown in the sidebar (prepared and verified through the public UI)
sessionFlow.sessionASid: sessionId of session A (from the app's own messages request)
sessionFlow.sessionAProjectHash: projectHash of the fixture project (from the app's own messages request)

sessionFlowThird.projectName: third fixture project name for the three-pane case

agent.projectName: fixture project that owns the agent parent session
agent.parentTitle: visible title of the parent session (first message text)
agent.toolUseId: toolu id of the Task/subagent call whose view this suite opens
agent.parentProjectHash: projectHash of the agent parent project
expectedBlockTypes: operator-observed block types in original order, e.g. prompt, thinking, tool_use, text
agent.stopTaskPathTemplate: /api/.../{pid}/... (route the app itself uses to stop an agent; copied from the app's own request)

agentCrossProject.projectName: a different fixture project than the currently open session
agentCrossProject.parentTitle: visible title of that cross-project parent session
agentCrossProject.toolUseId: toolu id of the subagent inside that cross-project parent

agentBackground.projectName: fixture project of a parent session that is not open in any pane
agentBackground.parentTitle: visible title of that parent session
agentBackground.toolUseId: toolu id of the subagent inside that parent

agentRunning.projectName: fixture project of the still-running parent
agentRunning.parentTitle: visible title of the running parent session
agentRunning.toolUseId: toolu id of the still-running subagent
agentRunning.parentPid: service pid of the running parent turn (from the app's own POST /api/chat response)

agentHistoryOnly.projectName: fixture project holding a finished subagent with nothing running
agentHistoryOnly.parentTitle: visible title of its parent session
agentHistoryOnly.toolUseId: toolu id of the finished subagent
agentHistoryOnly.parentPid: pid of the parent turn that produced it (kept for the stop entry, which must answer AGENT_NOT_RUNNING)

agentEnded.parentPid: pid of a parent turn whose subagent has already finished
agentEnded.toolUseId: toolu id of that finished subagent

agentFork.projectName: fixture project that owns both forked parents
agentFork.toolUseId: the same toolu id present in both forked parents
agentFork.forkAgentSessionId: the agent session id carried by the fork (used to show it has no run evidence)

agentOrphan.monitorEntryMarker: marker of a monitor entry whose parent session no longer exists (for 母会话不存在)

agentUnresolvedEntry.monitorEntryMarker: marker of a monitor entry without a usable parent identity (for 无法确定母会话)

agentNoPermission.monitorEntryMarker: marker of a monitor entry whose parent needs permission this host does not have (for 无权查看此会话)

agentLoadFailure.monitorEntryMarker: marker of a monitor entry whose history read fails on demand (for 加载失败，可重试)
